title: 第17章 你不知道吗第18章 熟练度
lines: 第17章你不知道吗？
两人半天没有说话。
乔桑一言不发地在一旁站着。
刺猬头朝姜流使了使眼色。
姜流好奇道：“你眼睛怎么了？”
太傻了。
刺猬头忍住扶额的冲动，憋住一个字：“钱。”
姜流这才意识过来，慌忙地从兜里掏出50联盟币递了过去。
真的是活该你单身！就不会加联系方式再转账吗！
“谢谢，我先走了。”乔桑接过钱笑道。
放学的高峰期就那么点时间，她还得趁这时间段多蹲点人。
“等等，你跟我也打一次吧。”刺猬头拦住了乔桑，“我也不要钱，你把培育火牙狗的秘诀告诉我就行了。”
乔桑摇摇头道：“我没秘诀。”
“不可能，要没秘诀的话火牙狗为什么那么听话？”刺猬头满脸不相信。
培育宠兽的方法不是什么秘密，大学还有关于培育宠兽的专业。
这种专业读出来的人联盟称之为培育师，像御兽师一样也是需要考级，从f级依次往上到sss级。
有些人契约了宠兽会专门找培育师来制定一系列的培育方案。
但也会人有自己独特的御兽方式不愿意跟人分享。
像江城的魏家，靠着能使妖精系超凡生物喜爱的食物，硬是让行踪不定的妖精系超凡生物出现在他们面前自愿成为他们的宠兽。
这种食物自然让人眼热，要是配方拿出来申请个专利或是售卖都能赚个盆满钵满。
可魏家偏只给自家人用。
后来几乎魏家的每个人都能拥有一只妖精系宠兽，300多年发展下来就有了妖精世家的称号。
刺猬头认为是乔桑不愿意告诉他。
他现在还记得学校里唯二契约火系宠兽之一的那位高二学长拿出他的火甲鼠想让它给学妹摸摸，结果那只火甲鼠出来就朝他喷了一口火焰。
人倒没事，就是头发焦了，剃了个光头，至今还每天戴着个帽子。
哪像这只火牙狗，那种情况下都能听话站着不动。
乔桑不解道：“我是它的御兽师，它听我话不是很正常？”
火牙狗点点头，算是认同自家御兽师的话。
刺猬头看着火牙狗这样子也不确定了，这只火牙狗瞧着那么乖难道是它本身的性格就是个乖巧的？
“我能摸摸它吗？”刺猬头问道。
“陈统同，别冲动。”姜流出言劝道。
学长成为光头的原因已经是全校都知道的事情，他怕陈统同成为学校的第二个光头。
“没事的，你摸吧。”乔桑一脸无所谓。
当初在宠兽基地的时候，还没有契约之前火牙狗也是愿意给她摸的。
陈统同心动了，他蹲下身看着火牙狗，刚伸出手。
火牙狗冲着他友好的展示了一下自己的利牙。
陈统同顿时缩回手，生怕下一秒火牙狗就给他来上一口。
“你还是跟我打吧，我也不要什么秘诀了，告诉我你平时怎么培育火牙狗就行。”陈统同起身说道。
“行。”乔桑答应下来。
虽然火牙狗满打满算才跟了她3，4天，但怎么说也算是有点培育心得。
姜流见两人决定下来，站出来说道：“这次裁判我来吧。”
content_en:
Chapter 17 Don’t you know?
The two didn't speak for a long time.
Qiao Sang stood aside without saying a word.
The hedgehog winked at Jiang Liu.
Jiang Liu asked curiously: "What's wrong with your eyes?"
Hedgehog head: "..."
So silly.
The hedgehog resisted the urge to hold his forehead and held back one word: "Money."
Jiang Liu finally realized it and hurriedly took out 50 alliance coins from his pocket and handed it over.
Hedgehog head: "..."
You really deserve to be single! Why don’t you add your contact information before transferring money?
"Thank you, I'll leave first." Qiao Sang took the money and smiled.
There was only so much time during the peak period after school, so she had to take advantage of this time to gather more people.
"Wait a minute, you can fight me once too." The hedgehog stopped Qiao Sang, "I don't want any money, just tell me the secret of breeding fire-toothed dogs."
Qiao Sang shook his head and said, "I have no secret."
"Impossible. If there wasn't a secret, why would Fire Tooth Dog be so obedient?" The hedgehog looked disbelieving.
The method of breeding pet animals is not a secret. The university also has a major on breeding pet animals.
The alliance of people who read this major is called a trainer. Like a beast master, he also needs to take a level test, starting from F level to SSS level.
Some people contract pet animals and will find breeders to formulate a series of breeding plans.
But there are also people who have their own unique ways of controlling animals that they don’t want to share with others.
For example, the Wei family in Jiangcheng relied on food that could make the extraordinary creatures of the fairy type like it, so they forced the elusive extraordinary creatures of the fairy type to appear in front of them and volunteer to become their pet beasts.
This kind of food is naturally eye-catching. If you apply for a patent on the formula or sell it, you can make a lot of money.
But the Wei family only uses it for their own family.
Later, almost everyone in the Wei family could own a fairy pet beast, and after more than 300 years of development, they became known as the Fairy Family.
The hedgehog thought it was Qiao Sang who didn't want to tell him.
He still remembered that the sophomore senior in high school who was one of the only two contracted fire beasts in the school took out his fire-armored rat and wanted it to be touched by his junior sister, but the fire-armored rat came out and sprayed a mouthful of flames at him.
He is fine, but his hair is burnt and he shaved his head. He still wears a hat every day.
Unlike this fire-toothed dog, he could remain obedient and stand still under such circumstances.
Qiao Sang was puzzled: "I am its beast master. Isn't it normal for it to listen to me?"
"Teeth."
Fire Fang Dog nodded, agreeing with his beastmaster's words.
The hedgehog looked unsure about the fire-toothed dog. Could it be that the fire-toothed dog looked so well-behaved because it had a well-behaved personality?
"Can I touch it?" asked the hedgehog.
"Chen Tongtong, don't be impulsive." Jiang Liu advised.
The reason why the senior became bald is already known to the whole school. He is afraid that Chen Tongtong will become the second bald person in the school.
"It's okay, just touch it." Qiao Sang looked indifferent.
Back when she was at the Pet Beast Base, the Fire Tooth Dog was willing to touch her before the contract was signed.
Chen Tongtong was moved. He squatted down and looked at the fire-toothed dog, and just stretched out his hand.
"Teeth."
The fire-toothed dog showed his fangs in a friendly manner.
Chen Tongtong immediately retracted his hand, fearing that the Fire Tooth Dog would bite him in the next second.
"You'd better fight me. I don't want any secrets. Just tell me how you usually breed Fire Tooth Dogs." Chen Tongtong stood up and said.
"Okay." Qiao Sang agreed.
Although the Fire Tooth Dog only stayed with her for 3 or 4 days, it was still a bit of a nurturing experience.
Seeing that the two of them had decided, Jiang Liu stood up and said, "I will be the referee this time."
